title: Scientists find traces of underground dwellers in mountains

tellings.quote: And I know some scientists who study caves and rocks. When I was in the Caucasus, when I was in India, in Tibet, in the Alaii, they found traces there,

plain: Scientists who study caves and rocks are said to have found traces of beings living underground in the mountains of the Caucasus, India, Tibet and the Altai. The teller is a former president of one of Russia's republics, who says he knows these scientists and repeats what they told him while travelling with them. He gives no more detail of what the traces were.
